reviews.author: Empire Motors Dispatch
reviews.text: Charles has been a life saver with towing our car. Reasonable price and reached the location in 25 minutes, really appreciate his timely work and professionalism through out the process.

reviews.author: Matthew Sapp
reviews.text: Gave them a call and they were able to get my truck in 20mins, sent photos after delivered. Great customer service and easy to pay.

reviews.author: Dennis TheMenace
reviews.text: my Rav4 broke down in a horrible spot, the first few companies i called said it would be a couple hours. Then i gave this company a called and he was there in 30 mins. HUGE life saver! HIGHLY RECCOMEND !

reviews.author: Nat C.
reviews.text: Awesome service! He arrived promptly and was very professional. Fairly priced as well. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Katrina Burden
reviews.text: Discount Beach Towing and Recovery LLC saved my life yesterday. The call was an easy process and the price was affordable. Charles definitely came to the rescue. He was very respectful with humor that helped my stress level completely. My truck was home in no time and was parked perfectly in my driveway. Thank you Charles we appreciate you so much.

reviews.author: James Bishop
reviews.text: Fast service, and awesome customer service. Gave them a call, Charlie showed up within about 15 minutes, had me loaded and rolling in about 5 minutes. Great company, quick reliable and professional. Recommend them 100%, don't hesitate to give them a call.

reviews.author: Ana Bailey
reviews.text: They were great, helped me set up an appointment to pick up my car quickly and efficiently. I would definitely use them again!

reviews.author: Nancy Lenthall
reviews.text: Charlie is amazing! He towed my RV through the Chesapeake Bay Bridge Tunnel after a snafu with the transmission. Originally I was told by my road side assistance company that it would be a 5 hour wait. Charlie made several calls to keep me updated. He shortly called back with the great news that he had figured out a way to personally come with a specialty truck to do the towing himself. This cut 4 hours off of the wait that I had anticipated. He is professional, competent, and showed empathy for my roadside needs. Thanks Charlie you are a true life saver!

reviews.author: Danny Clementine
reviews.text: Charlie is the man and his truck is unstoppable. If you’re stuck on OR off road give these guys a call. In our experience, the starter went out at ocean front late on a Sunday and Charlie came by within 20 minutes of calling and was the best price out of pocket (covered by our insurance anyway). Super friendly, super professional, plus if you’re off the road, on the beach, or in a tricky situation; save your tow company a call and just go straight to Charlie. Thankyou for the rescue Charlie!

reviews.author: Marc Smith
reviews.text: Unfortunately, I did not get the name of the person who towed my car, but they called 10 minutes out to let me know they were on their way. I got a quote through messages through Google maps, and they were by far cheaper than the other 3 quotes. I had my car towed from Virginia Beach to Chesapeake. They were prompt, friendly, and all around an awesome company for something stressful, like finding a towing company at the last second. 5 out of 5 stars for sure. Hope I don't need them anytime soon, but I'm definitely going to use them from here on out.

reviews.author: Wesley Bross
reviews.text: These guys are absolutely amazing. Honestly one of the best tow companies I've ever dealt with, especially when u live in or near va beach. After my experience with several tow companies, these are the guys I call every single time!!! They not only are very professional, but they also are very respectful for people's personal property as well as being upfront about absolutely everything including the price (which is better than 90% of other tow rates). These guys are my goto and I've never had a single problem and will definitely continue to use since all my project cars like to break on me :)

reviews.author: Andrew Page
reviews.text: Very fast and professional. I was in a tight spot with a dead car and needed to get it to the shop. Charlie showed up within 30 minutes of me calling and was great. I would highly recommend Discount Towing and Recovery, 5 stars.

reviews.author: Mason Resio
reviews.text: Charlie was very responsive and quick as can be. Got my car towed from the interstate and was he was so quick and communicative. If you call highly suggest Charlie taking care of you and our car !!

reviews.author: DeAndre’ Scott
reviews.text: Prompt and professional. Called on a Saturday morning, the truck arrived 45 mins later and got the job done. I tried to arrange towing of two vehicles with a few other companies weeks in advance, as I was coming from out of town. The others proved to be either unreliable or unresponsive. My experience with Discount Beach Towing & Recovery was the complete opposite. I wish I would’ve called them first and saved myself a lot of undue stress and uncertainty.

reviews.author: brent nelson
reviews.text: Hopped a hidden curb and popped both drivers-side tires at 10pm 300 miles from home. They were on site within 30 minutes to tow to tire place for early morning repair. Cost was what you'd expect from an emergency late-night towing service, and the service was great and professional. Saved the day.

reviews.author: Tyler Knight
reviews.text: I needed to have my truck towed to a local dealership and these guys were great. Quick response time, very affordable price, and they took care of my truck like it was their own. I will definitely use them again.

reviews.author: LaCrisha Kellum
reviews.text: Charles was awesome and affordable also referred me to a mechanic that was able to assist with my other needs. I highly recommend this service to anyone if you are in need of a tow truck, he will take care of you.

reviews.author: Josh Updegrove
reviews.text: This place had my back! I talked to Charles on the phone after I shredded a tire and he was out in 20 minutes to give me a tow! Other companies told me it was gonna cost me 350 dollars which is crazy! Charles gave me a reasonable price and was a total professional!

reviews.author: Magdalene Dieter
reviews.text: My tow truck driver Charlie was very quick and affordable. He made the whole process very easy and painless. I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Dallas Hicks
reviews.text: It was pouring rain and he came out and still did it! Super careful with my STI and did an absolutely amazing job! HIGHLY RECCOMEND!

reviews.author: AngrySailor Gaming
reviews.text: Service was great, gentleman was able to get me off base, meet up and gave me no trouble at all phenomenal service fully recommend.

reviews.author: Kathryn Robinson
reviews.text: The first towing company to get back to me, and responded very quickly! Very nice and professional, quick and will definitely be using again!

reviews.author: Caroline Hooks
reviews.text: I called so many places that were charging an arm and a leg this place was SO FAST I called at 830 they were here by 915 .They had an easy way to pay in person and the tow driver was super nice they made a bad day with my car a little better .I will forever recommend them.

reviews.author: Knockout King
reviews.text: First off let me say amazing company and fast.The gentlemen took very good care of my truck that I love so much

reviews.author: SSgt Rivera
reviews.text: Customer service was super helpful and they responded quick. Upon arrival they remained extremely professional, I highly recommend their services

reviews.author: Andre Chestnut II
reviews.text: Quick, kind, professional. Rode with him and he’s a cool guy. If I need a tow again, I’ll call for him

reviews.author: Ken Park
reviews.text: Discount Beach Towing was the only company willing to work this weekend. Quick, friendly and very professional.

reviews.author: Erin Ahlschlager
reviews.text: They were very prompt and am very happy with their service!! Will definitely use their service again!! Thank you!!
